facts.text: Founded in 1873, UAPB is an 1890 land-grant HBCU and Arkansas's only public historically black institution.

sources.title: Chancellor Prospectus - University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff
sources.quote: Created in 1873, UAPB is the second oldest public university in Arkansas and its only public historically black institution in the state. As an 1890 land-grant HBCU, UAPB grew out of the vision that higher education was important
